meta.name: churn-analysis
meta.description: Produce a structured churn analysis that separates avoidable from unavoidable churn. Use when investigating why customers are leaving, identifying at-risk segments, calculating net revenue retention, or building a retention intervention plan. Produces a churn report with rate calculations, categorised reasons by avoidability, segment breakdown, timing analysis, early warning signals, and prioritised interventions ranked by estimated impact.

copy.tagline: 分析客户流失原因，区分可避免与不可避免流失。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统分析客户流失数据并制定针对性留存策略。
